name: Sardines

low.description: About 3-4 whole sardines or 1/2 cup flaked

siboNotes: Excellent protein choice for SIBO as they're naturally FODMAP-free and provide gut-healing omega-3 fatty acids.
preparationTips: Choose sardines packed in olive oil or water rather than sauces that may contain garlic or onion
Fresh sardines can be grilled, baked, or pan-fried with FODMAP-friendly herbs
Remove bones if sensitive, though they're edible and provide extra calcium
Rinse canned sardines if avoiding excess sodium
nutritionalHighlights: High in omega-3 fatty acids EPA and DHA
Excellent source of protein and vitamin B12
Good source of selenium and vitamin D
